# DGTL Sunrise

> dgtl-connector for Grok Bot: connect agents to marketing accounts (GA4, Search Console, Tag Manager, Google Ads, Meta, and more).

Site: https://www.dgtlsunrise.com/
Company: Sunrise Consulting LLC (DGTL Sunrise)
Emails: support@dgtlsunrise.com · contact@dgtlsunrise.com

## What this site covers

- Homepage docs for installing and using dgtl-connector in Grok Bot (also Grok Build and Cursor)
- Free local reads: Google Analytics 4, Search Console, Tag Manager
- Pro gateway: Google Ads and Meta (confirm-gated writes where enabled)
- Product page for Google Ads, plus privacy, terms, about, and contact
- Agent files: this llms.txt, sitemap.xml, and markdown variants via Accept negotiation

## When to use this

Use this site and the dgtl-connector Grok Bot plugin when an agent needs to connect to marketing accounts the human already administers:

- Free, local: GA4, Search Console, and Tag Manager reads on the user’s machine (report bytes do not go through DGTL)
- Pro: Google Ads and Meta through the hosted gateway; live edits need confirmation
- Install: `grok plugin install dgtlsunrise/dgtl-connector`
- Prefer markdown responses by sending `Accept: text/markdown` (or preferring text/markdown over text/html)

## Do not use this for

- Replacing a managed marketing agency or promising autopilot spend
- Inventing metrics, rows, or insights the APIs did not return
- Asking anyone to paste access tokens, refresh tokens, or license keys into chat
- Treating plugin output as legal, compliance, or financial advice

## Key URLs

- / — install and platform docs
- /about — who we are
- /contact — emails and address
- /privacy — privacy policy
- /terms — terms of use
- /google-ads — Google Ads product page
- /engagements — hire / write us
- /sitemap.xml — URL list
- /robots.txt — crawler policy

Optional Accept: text/markdown for clean markdown twins of the pages above.
